title: Powdered Snow Highlighter
description: Outlines and highlights Powdered Snow blocks to prevent you from falling into traps and freezing.
body:
## About This Pack
Tired of falling into hidden traps and freezing to death? This lightweight texture pack highlights **Powdered Snow** blocks, making them instantly visible so you can safely navigate snowy biomes, mountains, and PvP traps.

## Features
* Clearly outlines/highlights Powdered Snow blocks.
* Works perfectly in Survival, Hardcore, and PvP scenarios.
* Lightweight and optimized (no FPS drops).

## Compatibility
* **Mod Compatibility:** Works with or without OptiFine / Iris.

## 📥 Availability
* **Java Edition:** Download right here on Modrinth!
* **Bedrock Edition:** Available on our CurseForge page (Windows, Mobile, Xbox, PlayStation).

---

## 🛠️ How to Install

### For Java Edition (Modrinth)
1. Download the `.zip` file from the **Versions** tab.
2. Open Minecraft and go to **Options** > **Resource Packs** > **Open Pack Folder**.
3. Drag and drop the downloaded `.zip` file into that folder.
4. Select the pack from the "Available" list in Minecraft and move it to "Selected".

### For Bedrock Edition (CurseForge)
1. Download the `.mcpack` file from the **Files** tab.
2. Double-click or tap on the downloaded file. 
3. Minecraft will open automatically and import the pack.
4. Go to **Settings** > **Global Resources** > **My Packs**, click on this pack, and select **Activate**.
